description: This file is a controller module for handling dashboard-related HTTP requests in a Node.js application. It defines an exported asynchronous function that retrieves dashboard summary data via a service call and responds with JSON data, or passes errors to the next middleware.

methods.name: handleDashboardSummary(req, res, next)
methods.description: Handles an HTTP request to fetch the dashboard summary, calls the service function, and responds with JSON data or forwards errors.
